document.text:
Gene expression begins when RNA polymerase binds near a gene in DNA. During transcription, RNA polymerase uses the DNA sequence as a template to create messenger RNA. The messenger RNA then leaves the nucleus and carries the encoded information to a ribosome.

During translation, the ribosome reads messenger RNA and joins amino acids into a polypeptide. Transfer RNA brings particular amino acids to the ribosome. The order of codons in messenger RNA determines the order of amino acids in the polypeptide.

The polypeptide folds into a functional protein. Regulatory proteins can increase or decrease transcription by affecting whether RNA polymerase binds, so regulation of transcription changes how much protein the cell produces without changing the DNA sequence.

entities.name: Gene expression
entities.description: The overall process by which genetic information is used to produce protein.

entities.name: RNA polymerase
entities.description: An enzyme that binds near a gene in DNA and uses DNA as a template during transcription.

entities.name: DNA
entities.description: The nucleic acid whose sequence serves as a template during transcription.

entities.name: Gene
entities.description: A DNA region near which RNA polymerase binds to begin gene expression.

entities.name: Transcription
entities.description: The process in which RNA polymerase uses DNA as a template to create messenger RNA.

entities.name: Messenger RNA
entities.description: RNA produced during transcription that carries encoded information to a ribosome.

entities.name: Nucleus
entities.description: The cellular compartment from which messenger RNA exits before carrying information to a ribosome.

entities.name: Ribosome
entities.description: The cellular structure that reads messenger RNA during translation and joins amino acids into a polypeptide.

entities.name: Translation
entities.description: The process in which a ribosome reads messenger RNA and joins amino acids into a polypeptide.

entities.name: Amino acid
entities.description: A molecular building block joined into a polypeptide during translation.

entities.name: Polypeptide
entities.description: A chain of amino acids produced during translation that folds into a functional protein.

entities.name: Transfer RNA
entities.description: RNA that brings particular amino acids to the ribosome.

entities.name: Codon
entities.description: A unit in messenger RNA whose ordered sequence determines the order of amino acids in the polypeptide.

entities.name: Functional protein
entities.description: The functional protein resulting when a polypeptide folds.

entities.name: Regulatory protein
entities.description: A protein that affects whether RNA polymerase binds and can increase or decrease transcription.

entities.name: Amount of transcription
entities.description: The amount of transcription regulated by regulatory proteins.

entities.name: Protein production by the cell
entities.description: The amount of protein produced by the cell as affected by transcriptional regulation.
